description: Scoring rules for the IEEE-14 teaching demo (5 representative days x 24 one-hour periods). Identical to dispatch-scoring-representative-v1 (ten-year present value, r = 7%, IT value 1000 $/MWh, capital charged once, daily_exact_cycle storage); the period weights come from the demo package's day weights.

weighting_provenance.formula: w_t = time_step_hours * day_weight(t) * A, A = sum_{y=1}^{10} (1 + r)^(-y)
applies_to: energy purchase cost at LMP (weeks with energy cost enabled)
private generator operating cost (80/150/250 $/MWh over 25/50/25% of capacity)
weighting_provenance.not_weighted: site, generator and storage capital costs (charged once, undiscounted)
weighting_provenance.day_weights: represented calendar days of each representative day, scaled to sum to 365 (see the package manifest)
weighting_provenance.discount_rate_note: instructor-chosen real discount rate of 7% over a ten-year planning life
weighting_provenance.served_load_mwh_note: reported served load is in MWh per represented year (weighted energy / A)

it_value_provenance.basis: instructor-chosen net margin of served computational load
it_value_provenance.context: Between colocation rent (about $270/MWh of IT load) and GPU-cloud revenue (about $1,700/MWh); 1,000 $/MWh is a round instructional net margin.
it_value_provenance.break_even_note: site cost / (IT value x 8760 h x A) = 25e6 / (1000 x 8760 x A): a site must be served about 41% of its connection capacity on average to recover its site cost.

generator_provenance.capital_cost_basis: Installed on-site gas engines and aeroderivative turbines cost about $1,700-2,000/kW (Rabobank 2026, https://www.rabobank.com/knowledge/d011524694-the-sprint-data-centers-are-building-a-parallel-energy-system-in-the-us); EIA-based figures in a Texas PUC filing give about $1,430/kW for aeroderivative turbines and $2,240/kW for internal-combustion engines. $2,000/kW is a round instructional value in that range.
generator_provenance.max_generator_to_connection_ratio_basis: G <= C: a site's generator may serve its whole load, with no run-hour limit (a site with G = C can run off the grid).

storage_cost_provenance.currency_year: 2022 USD for capital benchmarks; nominal instructional coefficients
storage_cost_provenance.basis: rounded 2028 moderate four-hour projection from NREL's 2023 utility-scale battery cost update
storage_cost_provenance.evaluator_mapping: Storage operating cost is not charged; one exact daily cycle per representative day, starting and ending at half energy.

allocation_rule: When the submitted plans do not fit the grid together, every site i gets a fraction alpha_i in [0, 1] that scales its connection, generator and storage capacities. The fractions maximize the total served connection capacity sum_i alpha_i C_i over the 120 periods (storage cycling daily); ties are broken by minimizing sum_i C_i (1 - alpha_i)^2, which makes the allocation unique. There is no minimum allocation. Capital is charged on the allocated capacities.
max_team_connection_capacity_basis: Each team may request at most 1,000 MW of connection capacity in total per submission. The reference plan for absolute points is 1,000 MW run off the grid (G = C).
